summary: Read one string. Cut it into contiguous pieces that follow one another and together cover the original string exactly. Each piece must match itself when its characters are read from the left and from the right. A piece made of one character always qualifies. Find every way to place those cuts. For each way, write the pieces in the order they occur in the original string.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one token of text without spaces.
